title: Vantrilex Kit Lockfile
description: Pinned kit (Vantrilex Core) plus the pending list. Compatible with registry/schema/catalog-v3.schema.json: a verified entry MUST carry a non-null install_cmd, and a null install_cmd MUST be recorded unverified. The component 'kind' enum tracks the catalog schema's enum; a kind is added here when the Lock begins pinning it, and the extensible-kind mechanism itself lives in the top-level $comment of registry/schema/catalog-v3.schema.json.

lockfileVersion.description: Lockfile format version. Version 1 is the only version this schema accepts.

kit.description: Kit selector. The Tier-0 set is always named vantrilex-core.

mcp_cap.description: Maximum number of tier-core MCP entries allowed in components. Mirrors the Tier-0 context-budget cap.

components.description: Pinned kit entries, one per locked (id, kind) pair.

kind.description: Component family. registry/schema/catalog-v3.schema.json owns the full enum and the mechanism for adding a kind; this enum grows only when the lock pins that kind. 'theme' pins an OpenCode CLI theme JSON shipped under registry/themes/ and installed by a file copy, never by a bare filename. 'prompt', 'dataset', 'template', 'policy', 'benchmark' and 'workflow' pin file-copy components shipped under registry/prompts/, registry/datasets/, registry/templates/, registry/policies/, registry/benchmarks/ and registry/workflows/ respectively.

allOf.$comment: A verified entry MUST carry a runnable install command; a null install_cmd is recorded unverified.

pending.description: Kit members that are not yet built. Every pending id MUST be absent from components.
